text_block_list.text:
With a breathtaking run, Air Groove 
claimed victory in the Hanshin JF.

However, this place was still merely a 
stepping stone toward the ideals she 
championed.

In order to become the kind of figure that 
countless other Umamusume aspired to be—

Without a hint of hesitation, she declared 
her goal of pursuing the Triple Tiara 
route, running through all three races: 
the Oka Sho, the Oaks, and the Shuka Sho.
